LESSON: COHERENCE WRITING

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: Writing 3.1 Guided Writing (Vocabulary) (1 session) By the end of the sub- stran
Topic 3.8: Coherence Writing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Coherence Writing. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do we ensure our writing is coherent?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify coherence markers in writing
2. write coherent texts using guided writing strategies

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: COHERENCE WRITING
This lesson teaches Coherence Writing for Grade 9 GERMAN.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify coherence markers in writing
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. write coherent texts using guided writing strategies
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Coherence Writing using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Coherence Writing above.
2. Explain Coherence Writing to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Coherence Writing.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Coherence Writing with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Coherence Writing important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we ensure our writing is coherent?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify coherence markers in writing
2. write coherent texts using guided writing strategies

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
